description.para: This register holds the interrupt status flags for the Spi device.

This register is used to enable interrupt sources for the IIC device. Writing a '1' to a bit in this register enables the corresponding Interrupt. Writing a '0' to a bit in this register disables the corresponding Interrupt.
IISR/IIER registers have the same bit definitions and are only defined once.

detaileddescription.para: Txing=1
NO ack = 1

briefdescription.para: Disables all interrupts for the device at the global level.

detaileddescription.para: This macro disables all interrupts for the device by writing to the Global interrupt enable register.

parameterdescription.para: The base address of the IIC device.

simplesect.para: C-style signature void XIic_IntrGlobalDisable(u32 BaseAddress)

briefdescription.para: Enables interrupts from the device at the global level.

detaileddescription.para: This macro writes to the global interrupt enable register to enable interrupts from the device. This function does not enable individual interrupts as the Interrupt Enable Register must be set appropriately.

parameterdescription.para: The base address of the IIC device.

simplesect.para: C-style signature void XIic_IntrGlobalEnable(u32 BaseAddress)

briefdescription.para: Determines if interrupts are enabled at the global level.

detaileddescription.para: Determines if interrupts are enabled at the global level by reading the global interrupt register.

parameterdescription.para: The base address of the IIC device.

listitem.para: TRUE if the global interrupt is enabled.
FALSE if global interrupt is disabled.

simplesect.para: C-style signature int XIic_IsIntrGlobalEnabled(u32 BaseAddress)

briefdescription.para: Sets the Interrupt status register to the specified value.

detaileddescription.para: This register implements a toggle on write functionality. The interrupt is cleared by writing to this register with the bits to be cleared set to a one and all others to zero. Setting a bit which is zero within this register causes an interrupt to be generated.

This function writes only the specified value to the register such that some status bits may be set and others cleared. It is the caller's responsibility to get the value of the register prior to setting the value to prevent an destructive behavior.

parameterdescription.para: The base address of the IIC device.
The value to be written to the Interrupt status register.

simplesect.para: C-style signature void XIic_WriteIisr(u32 BaseAddress, u32 Status)

briefdescription.para: Gets the contents of the Interrupt Status Register.

detaileddescription.para: This register indicates the status of interrupt sources for the device. The status is independent of whether interrupts are enabled such that the status register may also be polled when interrupts are not enabled.

parameterdescription.para: The base address of the IIC device.

simplesect.para: The value read from the Interrupt Status Register.
C-style signature u32 XIic_ReadIisr(u32 BaseAddress)

briefdescription.para: Sets the contents of the Interrupt Enable Register.

detaileddescription.para: This function writes only the specified value to the register such that some interrupt sources may be enabled and others disabled. It is the caller's responsibility to get the value of the interrupt enable register prior to setting the value to prevent a destructive behavior.

parameterdescription.para: The base address of the IIC device.
The value to be written to the Interrupt Enable Register. Bit positions of 1 are enabled. Bit positions of 0 are disabled.

simplesect.para: C-style signature void XIic_WriteIier(u32 BaseAddress, u32 Enable)

briefdescription.para: Gets the Interrupt Enable Register contents.

parameterdescription.para: The base address of the IIC device.

simplesect.para: The contents read from the Interrupt Enable Register. Bit positions of 1 indicate that the corresponding interrupt is enabled. Bit positions of 0 indicate that the corresponding interrupt is disabled.
C-style signature u32 XIic_ReadIier(u32 BaseAddress)

briefdescription.para: Clears the specified interrupt in the Interrupt Status register.

detaileddescription.para: This macro clears the specified interrupt in the Interrupt status register. It is non-destructive in that the register is read and only the interrupt specified is cleared. Clearing an interrupt acknowledges it.

parameterdescription.para: The base address of the IIC device.
The bit mask of the interrupts to be cleared.

simplesect.para: C-style signature void XIic_ClearIisr(u32 BaseAddress, u32 InterruptMask)

detaileddescription.para: Receive data as a master on the IIC bus. This function receives the data using polled I/O and blocks until the data has been received. It only supports 7 bit addressing mode of operation. This function returns zero if bus is busy.

parameterdescription.para: The base address of the IIC device.
The 7 bit IIC address of the device to receive the data from.
Pointer to the buffer to hold the data that is received.
The number of bytes to be received.
